data.name: Winonah
data.gender_notes: Winonah is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘wynn’ meaning friend and ‘anah’ meaning to love or to embrace. Winonah means a friend to all. The name Winonah carries the meaning “Friend to all” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Winonah usually hope their child will grow to embody friend to all and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of love and unity.
data.etymology: Winonah belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend to all.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Winonah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
